[{"insert":"Isometric Fatigue Shoulders

This piece pairs holds with constant movement to build shoulder and grip strength without beating up your joints. The carries and waiter curls are the isometric part, where you hold a hard position while everything shakes, building strength in a way normal reps don't. Keep a steady pace and rest about 60 seconds between sets. Holding heavy under control is the whole point, so don't rush it.
"}]
